description: Add the mm-based receipt-template data model, the mandatory block-list->canvas migration, and the new store actions to receiptStore.ts; AND (same commit) remove the old block-layout builder + per-branch receipt entry from WebSimpleScreens.tsx and rewrite receiptStore.test.ts for the new interface. The design (§1.4, §4, §7) REQUIRES these three edits to ship together so there is no self-inconsistent interim where the removed setters still have callers. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 except that they depend on this; must be first.
steps: In src/store/receiptStore.ts ADD types per design §1.1: PaperPresetId ('58mm'|'80mm'|'A4'|'A5'|'custom'), PaperSpec {preset,widthMm,heightMm:number|null,marginMm}, ReceiptElementType, ReceiptFieldKey (exact enumerated union from §1.1 — includes docTitle/cashier/payMethod/buyer*/preVatAmount/cancelReason/items/logo/qr; NO received/change), ElementAlign, ReceiptElementStyle, ReceiptElement {id,type,xMm,yMm,wMm,hMm,z,style,text?,field?}, ReceiptTemplate {version:1,paper,elements}. Add `template?: ReceiptTemplate` to ReceiptConfig. KEEP all existing ReceiptConfig fields and KEEP ReceiptBlock/ReceiptBlockId/ReceiptBlockAlign/DEFAULT_LAYOUT/mergeLayout.

Add DEFAULT_PAPER and PAPER_PRESETS (§1.3), a self-rolled genId(), and the pure function migrateLayoutToTemplate(saved) (§1.5): keep only visible!==false blocks in saved order, stack them (x=marginMm, y starts at marginMm then advances by rowH per block: logo 22, items 30, totals 8, single-line text 6; w=widthMm-2*marginMm), map each ReceiptBlockId to the element per the §1.5 table (payment -> DROPPED, emit no element), carry block.align into style.align, seed paper from config.paperSize ('58mm'|'80mm'|'A4' -> preset else DEFAULT_PAPER), garbage/undefined -> DEFAULT_TEMPLATE. Define DEFAULT_TEMPLATE = migrateLayoutToTemplate(DEFAULT config) so fresh + migrated installs share seeding.

In ReceiptStoreState REMOVE setLayout/reorderLayout/toggleBlock/setBlockAlign (signatures + impl). ADD actions per §1.4: setTemplate(t), setPaper(p), addElement(Omit<ReceiptElement,'id'|'z'>):string, updateElement(id,patch), moveElement(id,xMm,yMm), resizeElement(id,wMm,hMm), removeElement(id), duplicateElement(id):string. Store enforces invariants: unique id (genId), monotonic z=max(z)+1, w/h floored at 2mm, x/y clamped >=0. Keep setConfig.

Bump persist version 1->2. Add migrate(persisted,fromVersion): for fromVersion<2 return blob with config.template = migrateLayoutToTemplate(config). Extend the existing merge to be idempotent keyed SOLELY on template well-formedness (template?.version===1 && Array.isArray(template.elements)): if well-formed keep it, else config.template = migrateLayoutToTemplate(config). merge STILL calls mergeLayout(saved?.layout) and RETAINS config.layout.

In src/screens/web/WebSimpleScreens.tsx DELETE the entire `import { getOrderedBlocks, buildReceiptHtml, ReceiptSampleData } from '../../utils/receiptLayout'` line (~L21). From the kept `../../store/receiptStore` import drop ReceiptBlockId/ReceiptBlockAlign once unreferenced; keep useReceiptStore. DELETE ReceiptLayoutBuilder, BLOCK_LABELS, ALIGN_OPTIONS, PREVIEW_DASH_BEFORE, renderPreviewBlock, PreviewFields, the sampleData object (~L2130), and in SettingReceiptScreen remove the reorderLayout/toggleBlock/setBlockAlign selectors (~L2089-2091), the 'จัดวางบิล' builder section, the Preview section, openPrintPopup, and the Capture section. KEEP SettingReceiptScreen Sections 1-3 + save button; ADD a short Thai note that layout editing now lives in the 'แก้ไขรูปแบบบิล' menu.

In src/screens/web/WebSimpleScreens.tsx remove the per-branch receipt entry (Decision B §4): delete the receiptBranchId/setReceiptBranchId state (~L524), its early-return branch (~L604-605: `if (receiptBranchId) return <SettingReceiptScreen .../>`), and the per-branch 'บิล' TouchableOpacity button (~L672-680 with onPress setReceiptBranchId(b.id)). Keep the general Settings->บิล entry (subView==='receipt', ~L3130).

In src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.test.ts REMOVE the describe('receiptStore — setters') block. Change beforeEach to `useReceiptStore.getState().setConfig({ layout: DEFAULT_LAYOUT.map(b => ({ ...b })) })` (setLayout no longer exists). KEEP the 'DEFAULT layout — 12 blocks in order', mergeLayout, and persist-key tests unchanged (config.layout is retained).
acceptance_criteria: receiptStore.ts compiles with the new template model and new actions; the four layout setters are gone from ReceiptStoreState and no file references them.
WebSimpleScreens.tsx no longer imports from utils/receiptLayout, no longer references ReceiptLayoutBuilder or the per-branch receiptBranchId entry, and keeps the shop-info Sections 1-3 + save.
receiptStore.test.ts has no setters describe block, uses setConfig in beforeEach, and its retained tests still pass.
`npm run lint` shows NO NEW errors in receiptStore.ts, WebSimpleScreens.tsx, or receiptStore.test.ts versus the 13-error baseline.
`npm test` passes all unit tests with only the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures remaining.
verification: Run `npm run lint` from the worktree and confirm the error list contains no NEW entries for src/store/receiptStore.ts, src/screens/web/WebSimpleScreens.tsx, or src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.test.ts (baseline = 13 errors in BranchSelector/DatePicker/PermissionMatrixScreen/RoleManageScreen/WebUserStaffScreen/errorTracking only).
Run `npm test` and confirm unit tests pass (62+ green) with only engine.test.ts, SyncService.test.ts, branchPermissionStore.test.ts failing to load (pre-existing).
Commit all three files together on branch feat/receipt-designer2 (local only, no push).
findings: Implemented in src/store/receiptStore.ts. EXACT EXPORTED NAMES for later features: types PaperPresetId, PaperSpec, ReceiptElementType, ReceiptFieldKey, ElementAlign, ReceiptElementStyle, ReceiptElement, ReceiptTemplate; consts DEFAULT_PAPER, PAPER_PRESETS (Record over '58mm'|'80mm'|'A4'|'A5', NO 'custom' key), DEFAULT_TEMPLATE (export name is DEFAULT_TEMPLATE); functions genId(): string, migrateLayoutToTemplate(saved?: Partial<ReceiptConfig>|null): ReceiptTemplate. Store actions (names exactly as design §1.4): setTemplate(t), setPaper(p), addElement(Omit<ReceiptElement,'id'|'z'>):string, updateElement(id,patch), moveElement(id,xMm,yMm), resizeElement(id,wMm,hMm), removeElement(id):void, duplicateElement(id):string. duplicateElement returns '' if id not found (addElement/duplicate never throw). ReceiptConfig now has optional `template?: ReceiptTemplate`. KEPT: ReceiptBlock/ReceiptBlockId/ReceiptBlockAlign/DEFAULT_LAYOUT/mergeLayout and config.layout (deliberately retained). ReceiptElementStyle.color is optional (undefined by default); baseStyle() seeds fontSize 11, bold false, border false, borderWidthMm 0.3. Internal helpers blockToElement/blockRowHeight/baseStyle/paperFromConfig/isWellFormedTemplate are NOT exported. Persist: name 'pos-receipt', version bumped 1->2, migrate() for fromVersion<2 sets config.template=migrateLayoutToTemplate(config); merge() is idempotent keyed on isWellFormedTemplate (version===1 && Array.isArray(elements)) and still calls mergeLayout. migrateLayoutToTemplate: payment block DROPPED (no element), billInfo -> TWO field elements (billNo then dateTime), align carried into style.align, paper seeded from config.paperSize else DEFAULT_PAPER, garbage/undefined -> DEFAULT_TEMPLATE. WebSimpleScreens.tsx: removed utils/receiptLayout import entirely, dropped ReceiptBlockId/ReceiptBlockAlign from receiptStore import (kept useReceiptStore), deleted ReceiptLayoutBuilder/BLOCK_LABELS/ALIGN_OPTIONS/PREVIEW_DASH_BEFORE/renderPreviewBlock/PreviewFields/sampleData/openPrintPopup + builder/preview/capture sections, removed per-branch receiptBranchId state+early-return+'บิล' button; added Thai info note pointing to 'แก้ไขรูปแบบบิล'. Verification: npm run lint = 13 baseline errors only (no new in touched files); npm test = 57 unit tests pass, only engine/SyncService/branchPermissionStore suite-load failures remain (pre-existing).
